summary: Self-Employed Income Module UI Refinements - All 15 features tested and PASSED. Entity Name label updated, placeholder updated, frequency changed from chips to dropdowns, all conditional fields use dropdowns with proper date restrictions, Next Recurring Dates info boxes work correctly.

entity_name_label.test: Entity Name label shows 'Entity Name (Optional)' not 'Entity/Client Name'

entity_name_placeholder.test: Entity Name placeholder shows 'Example: Private Clinic, Freelance Portfolio, or Client Name'

frequency_dropdown.test: Frequency uses dropdown select (not chip buttons)
frequency_dropdown.evidence: Element tag is SELECT, dropdown with options: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Others

weekly_day_dropdown.test: Weekly frequency shows Day dropdown (not chips)
weekly_day_dropdown.evidence: SELECT element with options: Monday through Sunday

monthly_date_picker.test: Monthly frequency shows date picker with calendar icon on right
monthly_date_picker.evidence: type='date' input with Calendar SVG icon visible on right side

quarterly_flow.test: Quarterly frequency shows: Quarter dropdown → Month dropdown → Date picker with date restrictions
quarterly_flow.evidence: Quarter SELECT → Month SELECT → Date input with min/max restrictions (e.g., min=2026-01-01, max=2026-01-31 for January)

quarterly_months.test: Quarterly month dropdown only shows months from selected quarter

quarterly_date_restriction.test: Quarterly date picker restricts dates to selected month only

quarterly_recurring_dates.test: Next Recurring Dates info box appears for Quarterly
quarterly_recurring_dates.evidence: Info box shows 'Next Recurring Dates:' with dates like 'April 15, July 15, October 15' after selecting January 15

half_yearly_flow.test: Half-Yearly frequency shows: Half dropdown → Month dropdown → Date picker with date restrictions
half_yearly_flow.evidence: Half SELECT → Month SELECT → Date input with restrictions

half_yearly_months.test: Half-Yearly month dropdown only shows months from selected half

half_yearly_recurring_date.test: Next Recurring Date info box appears for Half-Yearly
half_yearly_recurring_date.evidence: Info box shows 'Next Recurring Date:' with date like 'September 20' after selecting March 20

yearly_flow.test: Yearly frequency shows: Month dropdown → Date picker
yearly_flow.evidence: Month SELECT with all 12 months → Date input with calendar icon

others_flow.test: Others frequency shows: Custom frequency text input → Date picker
others_flow.evidence: Text input with placeholder 'e.g., Every 2 weeks, Per project' → Date input with calendar icon

amount_in_words.test: Amount in words still displays below Expected Amount field
amount_in_words.evidence: Shows 'Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand Only' below amount field when 150000 entered

critical_code_review_comments: SelfEmployedIncome.js now matches JobIncome.js UI patterns for consistency
All frequency conditional fields use native HTML select elements with proper data-testid attributes
Date restrictions are properly implemented using min/max attributes
Next Recurring Dates calculation works correctly for Quarterly (shows 3 future dates)
Next Recurring Date calculation works correctly for Half-Yearly (shows 1 future date)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Self-Employed Income module UI refinements complete. All frequency options now use dropdown selects instead of chip buttons. Conditional fields (day, quarter, half, month, date) all use select dropdowns. Date pickers have calendar icons on right side. Quarterly/Half-Yearly have proper month restrictions and show Next Recurring Dates info boxes. Amount in words feature working correctly.
